blog_title: Benchmark Beaters Weekly: 212 Stocks Beating Their Benchmarks (November 23, 2026)
email_subject: Benchmark Beaters: DRX & REGN lead 212 stocks beating the market
preview_text: 61 Canadian and 151 U.S. names at six-month relative highs. Full table and charts inside.
intro: The latest Benchmark Beaters screen (as of November 23, 2026) found 212 Canadian and U.S. stocks outperforming their benchmarks, each hitting a new six-month relative high in the last five trading days.

In Canada, 61 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the TSX Composite, 30 of them new to the list this week. ADF Group Inc. (DRX) leads with a +119% six-month return, and Financials is the most represented sector with 14 names.

In the U.S., 151 stocks made a fresh six-month high relative to the S&P 500, 76 of them new to the list this week. Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc. (REGN) leads with a +52% six-month return, and Health Care is the most represented sector with 31 names.
